overview.title: Three screens run the complete scoring flow of a speech competition.
overview.subtitle: The admin console sets up dimensions and dispatches judges to the current project in real time; judges score on a weighted 0–100 multi-dimension scale; the results board ranks scored projects live by the scoring rule.
overview.entriesMeta: One live dataset · synced across pages

entryAdmin.title: Admin console
entryAdmin.description: Set competition details and dimension weights, maintain the project and judge roster, and dispatch any judge to the project they are currently reviewing.

entryJudge.title: Judge scoring
entryJudge.description: Judges sign in with their name and PIN, score the current project per dimension, and the system converts it to a weighted total in real time.

entryBoard.title: Results board
entryBoard.description: Project it to the main hall: current project, each judge's score, and a live ranking of scored projects.

overview.runTitle: One round from the host's perspective

steps.title: Set up rules
steps.text: Enter the project and judge roster and confirm dimension weights total 100% on a 100-point scale.

steps.title: Dispatch projects
steps.text: When a project's turn comes, the admin console switches judges to the project being reviewed.

steps.title: Judges score
steps.text: Judges instantly receive the current project, score each dimension and submit.

steps.title: View on board
steps.text: Scored projects appear on the board's ranking; scores update as submissions arrive.

guide: 1. During a speech, switch everyone to the current project; the judge screens update their title immediately.
2. If an individual judge needs to score a previous project, change their “Current project” separately in the table above.
3. Submitted scores are never lost by switching and can be aggregated per project.
4. Dispatch changes propagate to judge screens and the results board within 1–2 seconds; no manual refresh needed.
5. Judges can only submit scores while the scoring channel is open.
